user_story: As a user, I want to view the list of test cases on the Automation Exercise website so that I can select and learn about various testing scenarios. Acceptance Criteria: The user should be able to see the heading 'Test Cases' and a list of test cases, including 'Test Case 1: Register User', 'Test Case 2: Login User with correct email and password', and others, with links that expand to show details. The main page URL should be 'https://automationexercise.com/test_cases'.
